notes.title: A little more info about the game :)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27028381/64862d98836bbf45841fd423a4cc3a09f20aa1db.jpg[/img]
The game has been out for one day now, it's a really short time, but I got some questions and here are the answers :)

So some of the players were wondering when the game is being saved: it saves when you finish a quest. You can safely quit the game, no worries. By pressing Esc button it will warn you if progress won't be saved.

The game will be updated in the future. As you may have seen, there is a selection in the menu "Extra stories". There will be added more stories, you will be able to play as different characters, even monsters, use their unique attacks and discover more stories of the game's world.

If you make gameplay videos, feel free to play Guardian Of December and let me know about your videos, I will check them out, your feedback is important to improve the game.

You can contact me via:
Steam: http://steamcommunity.com/id/vidasgamedev
Twitter https://twitter.com/VidasSalavejus
Email: timorethegame@gmail.com
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC0B-jkuv9TO0sSH3ZqjIyOw
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/VidasSalavejus
